text: The ΜΕΓΑΛΟΣ ΔΙΑΓΩΝΙΣΜΟΣ overlay was a real contest (prize: two PyCon 2026 tickets, winner announced on Discord; entries existed only as Discord messages). The contest has ended, and on 2026-10-17 the owner had the overlay (templates/contest.html), its include in templates/base.html, and the Pages Function functions/api/contest.js removed. Recover them from commit ddbe31c if a similar contest is wanted again. The DISCORD_CONTEST_WEBHOOK_URL env var in Cloudflare Pages is no longer used by the code.

The create-meetup form and the Django admin deliberately produce DIFFERENT slugs for the same Greek title, and this is not a bug to fix. The form maps θ->th, ξ->ks and η/υ->i and handles the ου/αυ/ευ digraphs; the admin's prepopulated_fields still uses Django's stock urlify.js, which gives θ->8, ξ->3, η->h, υ->y. Stavros chose to leave the admin alone because he creates meetups through the form from now on and does not care what the admin does. Fixing the admin would mean forking Django's urlify.js into static/admin/js/, which was considered and rejected as not worth maintaining across Django upgrades. The 64 slugs that already exist were made by the admin and keep their old spelling; they were not backfilled, since slugs are stored and no URL breaks.

Staff session keys from the old database-backed sessions remain in the git history of db.sqlite3, across roughly 35 commits of that file, in the public repo. On 2026-09-15 the owner decided this is acceptable and explicitly declined a history rewrite. Do not propose rewriting history over this again without asking.

On 2026-09-15 the owner also chose signed-cookie sessions (SESSION_ENGINE = django.contrib.sessions.backends.signed_cookies), so that sessions survive a server restart. This was raised as a risk and accepted: SECRET_KEY is committed in the clear in pythess/settings.py, and it alone signs these cookies, so anyone with the repo can forge an admin session against a reachable server. The owner accepts this because the public site is static HTML and no Django server is ever reachable. Do not re-litigate this choice; the thing that would actually change it is exposing the server, which requires moving SECRET_KEY out of the repo first. DEBUG is also True and committed, still never raised as a task.
